title: Algebraic elements over a countable field form a countable set
statement: Let $F\to K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and suppose $F$ is countable, meaning that its underlying set admits an injection into $\mathbf N$. Then the subset $A=\{x\in K:x\text{ is algebraic over }F\}$ is countable, where algebraicity is as in [def-weil-algebraic-element].
